CITY INTELLIGENCE / THE DUBAI PILOT

The city is a map
of possibilities.

Go beyond climate awareness. LUNARIS Action's Dubai City Opportunity Atlas brings 12 neighborhood-level investigation concepts onto an interactive map—urban cooling, greener streets, biodiversity, water conservation, solar and waste.

Explore potential interventions, adjust illustrative impact assumptions, examine official strategy links, and express interest in helping. Real satellite validation, site permissions and operational community programs remain future steps, not completed claims.

Explore the City Opportunity Atlas ↗

SATELLITE EVIDENCE PIPELINE · VALIDATION PENDING
DUBAI 001 / THE EVIDENCE

Some cities hold
the heat after dark.

New in LUNARIS Action: an evidence-led Dubai case study exploring why daytime cooling and nighttime heat retention can coexist. Examine peer-reviewed findings, challenge a shade scenario, and reproduce an independent NASA POWER atmospheric analysis.

Research measurements are attributed, simulated shade is labeled, and unverified neighborhood sites remain proposals.

Explore the Dubai Heat Case Study ↗
DAY / RESEARCH−0.4°CNIGHT / SELECT ZONES+5°CReported study contrasts, not measured outcomes by LUNARIS
COP31 / AN EXPANDED WORLD OF ACTION

From everyday choices
to city-wide action.

Start with the Action Atlas and a guided city intervention scenario. HeatShield supports multilingual construction-worker heat guidance; GreenMiles now connects to a Carbon & Cost Wallet; FoodPrint houses Fridge Brain; WattFlow links to Home Resilience; and Climate Insurance gets a dedicated guide. Lumi helps people navigate the experience.

Experimental features are transparent about their limitations: no measured cooling outcomes, live SMS, bank connection, automated home-photo inspection or insurance recommendations.

THE TOOLS BEHIND THE CHOICES

More than a forecast.
A way forward.

Each tool answers a different decision, with the assumptions and evidence visible. They belong to one shared story, not six disconnected experiments.

Protect the people in it.

Outdoor activity windows, plus multilingual guidance on Dubai’s seasonal construction-work restrictions.

↗02 / FOODPRINTBuy thoughtfully.
